people.name: Achor_Valley
people.line: A valley near Jericho, where Achan was stoned.

people.name: Sharon
people.line: Coastal plain known for its beauty and fertility

translations.web: Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me.
translations.bsb: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for My people who seek Me.
